crops._comment: Source-frame (BodyParts3D, mm) constants measured from slices of the outer skin shell; see anatomy/README.md#cropping.

layers.label: Skin
layers.description: Thoracic skin envelope, cropped from the clavicles to below the costal margin.

layers.label: Rib cage
layers.description: Ribs, costal cartilages, sternum, clavicles and thoracic spine.

layers.label: Lungs & airway
layers.description: Five pulmonary lobes, trachea and main bronchi.

layers.label: Diaphragm
layers.description: Musculotendinous floor of the thoracic cavity.

layers.label: Heart
layers.description: Myocardium, valves, papillary muscles, great vessels and cardiac veins.

layers.label: Coronary arteries
layers.description: Epicardial coronary tree (right-dominant) mapped to the LAD / LCX / RCA model outputs.

nodes.label: Skin (thorax)
nodes.description: Skin of the anterior and lateral chest wall, cropped from the clavicles to below the costal margin with the upper limbs removed.

nodes.label: Left pectoralis major
nodes.description: Clavicular and sternocostal parts of the left pectoralis major, the large fan-shaped muscle overlying the anterior chest wall.

nodes.label: Right pectoralis major
nodes.description: Clavicular and sternocostal parts of the right pectoralis major.

nodes.label: Left ribs (1–12)
nodes.description: Left ribs 1–12: true ribs 1–7 articulate with the sternum through their costal cartilages, false ribs 8–10 join the costal margin and floating ribs 11–12 end free.

nodes.label: Right ribs (1–12)
nodes.description: Right ribs 1–12 forming the right half of the bony thoracic cage.

nodes.label: Costal cartilages
nodes.description: Hyaline costal cartilages: the individual cartilages of ribs 1–7 forming the sternocostal joints, and the fused cartilages of ribs 8–10 that form the costal margin.

nodes.label: Sternum
nodes.description: Manubrium, body and xiphoid process of the sternum; the heart lies directly behind its lower half.

nodes.label: Left clavicle
nodes.description: Left collarbone, strut between the sternum and the shoulder.

nodes.label: Right clavicle
nodes.description: Right collarbone, strut between the sternum and the shoulder.

nodes.label: Thoracic spine (T1–T12)
nodes.description: Twelve thoracic vertebrae forming the posterior wall of the thorax; the descending aorta runs along their left anterior surface.

nodes.label: Left lung
nodes.description: Left lung (upper and lower lobes). Its cardiac notch accommodates the heart, which is why most of the heart lies left of the midline.

nodes.label: Right lung
nodes.description: Right lung (upper, middle and lower lobes).

nodes.label: Trachea & bronchi
nodes.description: Trachea and bronchial tree; the tracheal bifurcation (carina) lies just above and behind the left atrium.

nodes.label: Diaphragm
nodes.description: Dome-shaped respiratory muscle; the inferior (diaphragmatic) wall of the heart rests on its central tendon.

nodes.label: Myocardium (anterior half)
nodes.description: Anterior half of the heart wall (epicardial and endocardial surfaces), opened along the long axis. Vertex colours carry approximate LAD / LCX / RCA perfusion-territory weights (AHA 17-segment convention) — not a lesion map.

nodes.label: Myocardium (posterior half)
nodes.description: Posterior half of the heart wall including the inferior (diaphragmatic) surface and the atria. Vertex colours carry approximate perfusion-territory weights — not a lesion map.

nodes.label: Mitral valve
nodes.description: Bicuspid valve between the left atrium and left ventricle; its leaflets are tethered to the LV papillary muscles by chordae tendineae.

nodes.label: Tricuspid valve
nodes.description: Three-leaflet valve between the right atrium and right ventricle.

nodes.label: Pulmonary valve
nodes.description: Semilunar valve at the right-ventricular outflow into the pulmonary trunk.

nodes.label: Papillary muscles
nodes.description: Right- and left-ventricular papillary muscles. The posteromedial LV papillary muscle usually has a single blood supply (RCA/PDA), which makes it vulnerable in inferior infarction.

nodes.label: Aorta
nodes.description: Ascending aorta, aortic arch and thoracic descending aorta. Both coronary arteries arise from the aortic sinuses just above the aortic valve.

nodes.label: Pulmonary artery
nodes.description: Pulmonary trunk and its right and left branches carrying deoxygenated blood from the right ventricle to the lungs.

nodes.label: Pulmonary veins
nodes.description: Pulmonary veins returning oxygenated blood from the lungs to the left atrium.

nodes.label: Superior vena cava
nodes.description: Superior vena cava draining the upper body into the right atrium.

nodes.label: Inferior vena cava
nodes.description: Terminal thoracic segment of the inferior vena cava entering the right atrium through the diaphragm.

nodes.label: Cardiac veins
nodes.description: Coronary sinus with the great, middle, anterior and posterior LV cardiac veins, which run alongside the coronary arteries and drain the myocardium into the right atrium.

nodes.label: Left main coronary artery
nodes.description: Short left main stem arising from the left aortic sinus and bifurcating into the LAD and LCX. The dataset has no separate left-main label, so this segment is not colour-coded by the model.
nodes.territory: Entire LAD and LCX territories (via its two branches)

nodes.label: Left anterior descending (LAD)
nodes.description: Runs in the anterior interventricular groove to the apex, giving diagonal branches to the anterolateral wall and septal perforators to the septum.
nodes.territory: Anterior wall, anterior two-thirds of the interventricular septum and the apex (AHA segments 1, 2, 7, 8, 13, 14, 17)

nodes.label: LAD septal perforators
nodes.description: Septal perforating branches of the LAD penetrating the interventricular septum.
nodes.territory: Anterior two-thirds of the interventricular septum

nodes.label: Left circumflex (LCX)
nodes.description: Runs in the left atrioventricular groove around the left border of the heart, giving obtuse marginal branches to the lateral wall.
nodes.territory: Lateral (anterolateral and inferolateral) wall of the left ventricle (AHA segments 5, 6, 11, 12, 16)

nodes.label: Right coronary artery (RCA)
nodes.description: Arises from the right aortic sinus and runs in the right atrioventricular groove to the crux of the heart; supplies the right ventricle, the SA and AV nodes (in most people) and, in right-dominant hearts, the inferior wall.
nodes.territory: Right ventricle, inferior wall and inferior septum (AHA segments 3, 4, 9, 10, 15)

nodes.label: Acute marginal branch (RCA)
nodes.description: Right (acute) marginal branch of the RCA running along the acute margin of the right ventricle.

nodes.label: Posterior descending artery (PDA)
nodes.description: Posterior interventricular branch; arises from the RCA in this right-dominant anatomy and runs in the posterior interventricular groove.
nodes.territory: Inferior wall and inferior third of the septum (AHA segments 3, 4, 9, 10, 15)

nodes.label: Posterolateral branch (RCA)
nodes.description: Right posterolateral branch continuing beyond the crux onto the inferolateral left ventricle.
nodes.territory: Inferior / inferolateral base of the left ventricle

nodes.label: RCA septal branches
nodes.description: Inferior septal branches arising from the PDA / RCA.
nodes.territory: Inferior third of the interventricular septum

atrial_landmarks._comment: Ventricular myocardium = thick wall (LV free wall, septum) or thin wall that is closer to the ventricular landmarks than to the inflow/outflow landmarks (RV free wall). Everything else (atria, auricles, great-vessel roots) fades to neutral. The LAD is deliberately not a landmark: its proximal segment runs beneath the left atrial appendage.
